attributions.says: Meta's investigation revealed links to actors in Iran.

narratives: Anti-Western and anti-imperialist themes, support for pro-Hamas activism, and opposition to African states normalising relations with Israel, posted by personas styled as local researchers, nurses and women's rights advocates.

sources.title: Semiannual Adversarial Threat Report, Second Half 2026

sources.title: Iran-Based Influence Operation Targeting Sub-Saharan Africa

notes: Meta removed 23 Facebook accounts, 13 Pages, 1 Group and 11 Instagram accounts. Meta says operators used profile pictures of local individuals overlaid with activist symbols and AI-made graphics. Activity years and languages are not stated.

name: Iran-based CIB network targeting Azerbaijan (Meta H2 2026)

attributions.says: our investigation found links to Azerbaijani individuals in Iran.

narratives: Pro-Iran and pro-Shia narratives, criticism of Azerbaijan's internal affairs and efforts to undermine confidence in its government, spread through single-topic brands posing as local Azerbaijani outlets.

name: Iran-based CIB network targeting the United States (Meta H2 2026)
operator: not named; Meta found links to actors in Iran

attributions.says: Although the people behind it attempted to conceal their identity, our investigation found links to actors in Iran.

narratives: Civic meme accounts run by personas posing as US activists, students and designers, posting on US politics (including anti-Republican views), the Israel-Palestine conflict and immigration, and tagging journalists and politicians to seek collaborations.
